audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Skill on rows 0-3, 5 and 6 while the content layer and packet both read Qiyana / Qiyana / Qiyana / Qiyana / Diana / Diana / Diana.
audit.why: Levels 1-5 are hers on the kit: Royal Privilege front-loads her first hit on you, Terrashape is a flat 7s 1100-range reposition that re-enchants off any wall, and Audacity is an 11s dash from 650 while you have no dash until 3.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to the content layer, every moved row's why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content referred to Diana's engage as 'Moonfall (E)' and to Qiyana's 'passive shield'. Moonfall is Diana's R (Lunar Rush is E), and Royal Privilege is bonus first-hit damage with no shield.
audit.why: Both kits. A player told to save 'Moonfall' for the engage will spend the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Named Lunar Rush (E) for the engage and replaced the shield claim with Terrashape's flat 7s reposition.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Qiyana ability was named anywhere and the packet flagged zero sequencing cues; the cooldowns field had no digit.
audit.why: Supreme Display of Talent is a flat 120s that must hit terrain to detonate into the stun — fight where there is no wall and her ultimate is a shove. Audacity (11/10/9/8/7) is her only dash onto you; Terrashape's flat 7s is what re-enchants her damage.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Audacity 11s/7s, Terrashape flat 7s and the 120s ultimate, with the terrain condition stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two bullets repeated the trade lines verbatim under unrelated titles, and sixteen fields called Qiyana 'he'.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and both bodies rewritten to their own titles around Terrashape's 7s and Lunar Rush's 14s.
